name: Rouge Patrol
source:
The war between Rouge and Bleue has gone beyond either nation's capacity to wage it. First they drafted the men and then boys… bereft of options women were conscripted in turn. Now, with all spent - and surrender unthinkable - the grinding machine of war has turned to girls. 

Having lost everything to Bleue, fourteen year-old Sergeant P.G. Tails swore she'd stop at nothing to achieve their destruction. But, as she leads her unit into the unending conflict, she begins to realise that the price of revenge may be paid, not by her, but the girls she has come to love.

Worse, she carries a secret that puts her in more danger from her friends than her enemies…

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811490/Defence_Club_Rouge_Patrol/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
红色和蓝色之间的战争已经超出了任何一个国家的发动能力。首先他们征召了男人，然后是男孩……失去了选择权的女人依次被征召入伍。现在，随着一切都耗尽了——投降是不可想象的——战争的磨砺机器已经转向了女孩。

十四岁的P.G. 中士在布鲁的手下失去了一切。塔尔斯发誓她会不惜一切代价摧毁他们。但是，当她带领她的部队陷入无休止的冲突时，她开始意识到，复仇的代价可能不是由她自己，而是由她所爱的女孩们付出。

更糟糕的是，她背负着一个秘密，这让她面临的危险比敌人更大，来自朋友的危险……

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1811490/Defence_Club_Rouge_Patrol/]Steam[/url]]
